# YOAZ — official illustration portfolio

YOAZ is a French illustrator, graphic designer and art director working between Paris and Amsterdam. His practice focuses on geometric, psychedelic and ornamental illustration for editorial, fashion, branding, events and public installations.

Official website: https://yoaz.fr/
Contact: yoaz@hotmail.fr

## Selected, independently readable client projects
- Adobe MAX — illustration and event environments: https://yoaz.fr/projets/adobe-max/
- PlayStation God of War — Paris Metro illustration: https://yoaz.fr/projets/playstation-god-of-war/
- Adidas Paris — illustrated apparel: https://yoaz.fr/projets/adidas-paris/
- Converse × Citadium — multi-format retail campaign: https://yoaz.fr/projets/converse-citadium/
- Relic Cipher Collection — embroidered apparel illustration: https://yoaz.fr/projets/relic-cipher/
- Fast Company — editorial illustration and stylized portraits: https://yoaz.fr/projets/fast-company/
